purpose: Completeness tail for the current RuneScape Wiki rare-component taxonomy. These are families not already represented by the planner's regional, 2026, Archaeology or perk dependency datasets.
taxonomy_note: The older PvME rare-component list used to seed this audit omitted Manufactured components. The current RuneScape Wiki material taxonomy includes Manufactured as a rare family, so the authoritative completeness count is 33.

remaining_component_routes.planner_value: The family is legitimate but is not a clean elective-region gate: Sirenic supply is distributed, while Ascension equipment provides an optional Kandarin route through the Monastery of Ascension.
Track for material completeness, but do not award a region for it; cabbage supply is effectively global and the component does not justify an elective-region score by itself.

Current PvME Invigorating recipes consume Culinary components. Culinaromancer gloves depend on Recipe for Disaster progression, so the official Equilibrium quest-auto-completion overlay should be applied before turning this into a manual regional gate.

Asgarnia has an efficient White Knight equipment route, but black equipment makes Knightly components nonexclusive. This matters for combinations such as Turtling 3 Taunting without pretending Asgarnia is mandatory.

Manufactured is a real rare component and participates directly in current Equilibrium perk recipes. The Wiki confirms many source items but still marks several special disassembly chances as under research, so the planner records source classes without inventing a per-item drop rate.
